- Signatory entity: Redwood signs as Redwood, Inc. If FathomAI requires a local subsidiary signature, please confirm exact legal name and address.

Required details for redline: (please provide where possible)

2) Exact billing contact + PO process (do you require a PO before invoice?).
3) Expected seat growth timeline and overage rules you'd like captured.
4) Any HIPAA / regulated data flags — we will need to know if PHI is in scope.
5) Security evidence: if you have SOC2 Type II specific asks, point to which controls matter most; otherwise we will send standard attachments (SOC2 attestation, penetration test summary).

Attachments I'll provide on my initial pass: seed-msa-redline-request.docx (high-level redline markers); I will not send a redline doc until I confirm a couple items above.
